tools.name: get_fax_price
tools.description: Calculate the pay-per-fax price for sending a fax to a specific number. No API key required. Supported: USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and 39 more countries (same list as sendfaxfast.com); premium-rate numbers are not supported.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Send a PDF document to a fax number. WITHOUT API key: returns a Stripe checkout link (pay-per-fax from $2.49) – the fax is sent after the user pays. tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Check the delivery status of a fax. Use token for pay-per-fax orders, fax_id for subscription orders (fax_id requires your API key; only your own faxes are visible).

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Get subscription plan details, remaining fax quota, and billing period. Requires your subscription API key (sff_...).

tools.name: list_fax_history
tools.description: List recent faxes sent from this subscription account. Requires your subscription API key (sff_...).

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Creates a secure one-time upload link (valid 30 minutes) for the fax document (PDF, JPG or PNG, max. 10 MB) – upload from phone or computer by drag & drop, file picker or camera. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "send_fax" is 1000 chars, far longer than this server's median (199). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
